rationale: HLT-POL-002 is marked authority_status = Superseded. A claim with a 2024 date of service must retrieve THIS version, not the current Gold PPO booklet, to be evaluated under the coverage terms that were actually in effect. Demonstrates that retrieval must be time-aware, not just attribute-aware.

State-mandated benefits can supplement or override the base national plan document. A claim for a CA member must additionally retrieve this addendum so a state requirement is not silently missed in favor of only the national policy.
